`GET /invoices/<id>` in `src/api/invoices.py` now returns a 404 when the invoice isn't in `_INVOICES`. I haven't run it or any tests.

The response is built with `problem(404, "Invoice not found", f"No invoice with id {invoice_id}")` from `src/api/errors.py`, as the project's API error-format convention requires. That gives an RFC 7807 `application/problem+json` body.

I used an absolute import, `from src.api.errors import problem`. Nothing else in `src/api` imports from a sibling module, so there was no existing style to match. `src/billing` uses relative imports, so say if you'd rather have `from .errors import problem`.
